package course

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// ListCourseI18n lists localizations for a course.
type ListCourseI18n struct {
	Courses    repository.CourseRepository
	CourseI18n repository.CourseI18nRepository
}

// Handle returns all localizations for a course.
func (uc ListCourseI18n) Handle(ctx context.Context, courseID string) ([]domain.CourseI18n, error) {
	if courseID == "" {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := uc.Courses.GetByID(ctx, courseID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return uc.CourseI18n.ListByCourse(ctx, courseID)
}
